node.statement: Construction of one spatial four-corner system. Define h_jk=Ha^Q_{P_j,P_k} and T=h_11 composed with v. The product, unit, upper-norm and adjoint clauses of conj-hcb together with def-extended-delta-inclusion imply, uniformly in n, that T is a dagger-preserving extended A_0*e-homomorphism for a universal A_0 (for example after enlarging C_H, A_0=4(C_H+1)). Apply node 1.2 at e small enough to get one exact unital dagger-homomorphism mu_11:M_r->B(H_1) with ||mu_11,n-h_11,n v_n||<=kappa*e, kappa=C_corr*A_0. It is nonzero, hence injective because M_r is simple, and it is onto because both spaces have dimension r^2 by node 1.1. Thus it is a spatial dagger-isomorphism: choose one unitary U_1:C^r->H_1 with mu_11(A)=U_1 A U_1^dagger. With the already fixed U_2, define mu_jk(A)=U_j A U_k^dagger for A in B(K_k,K_j). These four fixed level-one maps are exact, completely isometric, adjoint-compatible and multiplicative at all amplifications via I_n tensor U_j; no level-dependent choice is made.
